column3: MT 6:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. NASB sets the title in braces and puts “A Psalm of David” in parentheses; “on the sheminith” is rendered “upon an eight-stringed lyre,” and “discipline” as “chasten.”
Close to the Hebrew; “I am frail” is rendered “I am pining away,” and “disturbed” as “dismayed.”
Close to the Hebrew; “remembrance of You” is rendered “mention of You.”
Close to the Hebrew; “will accept” is rendered “receives.”
The Hebrew wishes “May they be ashamed”; NASB renders it as a future statement, and “a moment” as “suddenly.”
